editor.identity_source: T3 orchestrator_capabilities inherited runtime options, verified 2026-11-05

authorization: Explicit user authorization for this new independent attempt including GPU probes.

adaptive_budget.unit: One prompt and one generation, including activation inspection in that generation. No extra teacher-forced forwards.
adaptive_budget.preexisting_feedback: Original baseline RESULTS.md only. Old final data and evaluation traces excluded.

localization.capture: w2 input at the last token of each forward during the eight stock practice generations.
localization.method: Inspect negative activation times output-column projection onto desired-minus-actual unembedding rows at the first oracle/native-token divergence. This is a rough logit attribution, not a causal guarantee. No backpropagation, learned map, optimization, parameter fitting, or teacher-forced extra passes.
localization.selection: Manual choice up to eight columns. Inspect recurrent adverse attribution in later layers, including layer 22. Exclude all eight Sol selected layer-23 columns. No numerical candidate search.

selection.rule: Among the two candidates, maximize strict practice successes. Then minimize genuine stale/revocation failures, unchanged-order regressions, generated tokens, and intervention norm in that order; final tie chooses candidate-a. Freeze the winning tested candidate even if both fail to improve. Claim useful repair only if strict improvement and no unchanged-order regression.

control.type: random columns in the same layers with the same count and scaling factor as selected patch; reject selected columns
control.feedback: Eight practice control responses are recorded after selection is frozen and cannot change it.

evaluation.order: Each arm runs all cases, in manifest order. Model weights restore exactly between arms.
evaluation.final_handling: Parent generates fresh final cases after handoff. Separate local cases argument streams prompts to owned socket. Editor never opens cases or receives evaluation feedback.

compute.submission: ops/cluster.py with phase-scoped immutable bindings and exclusive ledgers
